stories.title: Why we’re going back to the games of our youth
stories.summary: As millennials return to the games of their youth, remakes of Star Fox and Halo suggest there is still plenty to learn from the past • Don’t get Pushing Buttons delivered to your inbox? Sign up here As much as some people more or less cease to listen to new music in their 30s , I have noticed a retreat to safe, familiar gaming territory among some of my fellow millennial gamers. Retro collections are started, or resumed; jewel-cases of PS1 classics or cardboard boxes with SNES or Mega Drive games have started to colonise the living-room shelves. stories.title: WAFCON: Morocco to face Cameroon Wednesday evening
stories.summary: Women's Africa Cup of Nations tournament hosts Morocco and Cameroon will face each other Wednesday evening at the Moulay El Hassan stadium.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: WAFCON: Morocco to face Cameroon Wednesday evening. Women's Africa Cup of Nations tournament hosts Morocco and Cameroon will face each other Wednesday evening at the Moulay El Hassan stadium. Source: Africanews English.
article_sentences: Women's Africa Cup of Nations tournament hosts Morocco and Cameroon will face each other Wednesday evening at the Moulay El Hassan stadium.
Their previous clash was back in 2000, when Cameroon came out on top, winning 4-1.
Morocco had initially taken the lead in that match, before the reversal of fortune for their opponents.
This marks seventh game against a host nation, and they are yet to win in their last six.
They have scored in just one of those games: when they drew 1-1 against Ghana in 2018.
Morocco, meanwhile, are aiming for a third WAFCON final, having won 2-1 over South Africa in the quarter finals.
They have won both of their previous semi finals, following extra time and penalties.
The team has qualified for the FIFA women’s World Cup in 2027, which will mark their second appearance at the tournament.
